map_info.name: Facade_Classical
map_info.description: The canonical expression of facade assembly. Symmetric composition, full column order applied, hierarchy unambiguous (base / piano nobile / attic), regular bay rhythm, framed by cornice and base. The principle clean.

learning_objectives: Recognise the principle applied without elaboration
Read symmetry as the rule's strongest signal
Identify the three vertical zones (base / piano nobile / attic) and their hierarchy

map_info.title: The Principle Clean

sp.name: Spawn
sp.description: Player spawn point — back-centre, facing the facade wall

t.name: Exit Portal
t.description: Continue to the next expression map (Facade_Baroque)

documentation.summary: Facade_Classical — the principle clean. A symmetric facade with all six compositional moves applied canonically.
documentation.layout: 10x6 walkable space. Spawn at back-centre, facing the facade wall (front row). Teleporter exit on side. Facade itself rendered along the front edge as a wall composition (artifacts queued for pass-3).
documentation.objective: Let the player stand in front of a facade where the principle is applied unambiguously, so the deviations the rest of the sequence will show have a baseline to deviate from.
key_elements: Facade composition on front wall (artifacts queued for next pass)
